summary: All 72 candidates (4 families x 3 prompts x seeds 11-16) exist as raw 48 kHz mono float32 WAV in assets/audio/gen/moss/raw/ with gen.json. Runs on native Windows with the RTX 5080 without compilation (TORCHDYNAMO_DISABLE=1). Same seed gives bit-identical files. Uncontended: 17-18 s per candidate (100 steps, bf16). While a game held the GPU, four candidates took 384-547 s, so seeds 11-13 were made first (the 3-minute rule), then 14-16 when the card was free again.

safety.vae_pickle: vae_128d_48k.pth read with pickletools before loading: globals are only collections.OrderedDict, torch.FloatStorage, torch._utils._rebuild_tensor_v2 (zip with weights/data.pkl); top-level dict has keys state_dict and metadata (metadata.kwargs plain ints, lists, bools). Loaded with torch.load(weights_only=True) with an EMPTY allow-list (no add_safe_globals), missing=0 unexpected=0 keys.
safety.patch: The makers' DAC.load (audiotools BaseModel.load) first tries torch.package and then torch.load without weights_only; adapter replaces DAC.load by a loader with weights_only=True (tools/sound/adapters/moss.py, _safe_dac_load), so neither path runs.
safety.other_weights: transformer and text encoder are safetensors; the makers' own load_state_dict_from_bin already uses weights_only=True.
safety.telemetry: searched moss_soundeffect_v2 source and audiotools for analytics/telemetry/posthog/sentry/wandb/requests/urllib: nothing in the inference path. diffusers has hub telemetry only in from_pretrained-style hub utils, not called; HF_HUB_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1, DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1, DO_NOT_TRACK=1 and HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 set in the adapter. Network use at run time not measured with a packet capture. tensorboard and protobuf are installed as dependencies of audiotools, not used.

problems: The GPU was shared with a game (Wow.exe, 4-4.6 GB, owned by the user, not touched). During that time candidates took 384-547 s (hull_1 s11 451 s, thruster_2 s11-s13 547/385/~400 s) versus 17-18 s uncontended; one run stalled for over 6 minutes and I stopped my own worker (the only processes I stopped) twice. To lower memory pressure the adapter now moves the text encoder (4 GB) and the denoiser (5.7 GB) to the CPU when they are not needed (encode, VAE decode) and calls empty_cache per candidate; this changes where weights sit, not the numbers (hull_1 s11 came out bit-identical to the version without it). It did not remove the slowdown; the slowdown ended when the game was gone.
The first 23 files were made by earlier versions of the adapter (no offload, no empty_cache); outputs are the same by the identity test but their synth_s are not comparable.
38 of 72 files have a peak of 0.999 or more (max 0.9996, none above 1.0): the model returns near full scale, no clipping measured beyond the peak, adapter does no gain.
The with_lock wrapper of the first full run was killed when I stopped its worker; the bench lock directory was released correctly each time.
notVerified: Nothing was listened to; whether any candidate is usable is the owner's.
Number of samples at the digital ceiling per file was not counted beyond peak.
Whether the model generalises to the prompts is not judged.
No network capture to prove absence of run-time calls; offline flags were set.
Training data, output terms and the DAC licence of the makers are not stated.
